description: Crypto Market Screener — fetches live crypto prices, market caps, volume, supply, and performance data from CoinGecko. Enter coin names/symbols (e.g. bitcoin, eth, sol) or set 'Include Top N' to pull the top coins by market cap. No API key required.

properties.title: Coin Names (stringList)
properties.name: coins
properties.description: Enter coin IDs, symbols, or names — one per line. Examples: bitcoin, eth, solana, dogecoin, pepe. Leave empty to use only Include Top N.

properties.title: Include Top N
properties.name: include_top
properties.description: Automatically include the top N coins by market cap. Set to 0 to use only the coins listed above. Max 250.

properties.title: Currency (select)
properties.name: vs_currency
properties.description: Quote currency for prices and market data.

properties.title: Max Results (number)
properties.name: max_results
properties.description: Maximum number of coins to return. CoinGecko free tier returns up to 250 per call.
